title: PaymentIntent
description: Canonical payment-initiation primitive (ADR-014). An intent to receive value into a payee wallet. Payment Links (ADR-013), QR (ADR-012) and Payment Requests are surfaces of a PaymentIntent. A PaymentIntent never holds or moves money; fulfilment produces exactly one Transfer that posts to the Ledger.

merchant_id.description: Merchant, when the payee is a merchant.

amount_minor.description: Amount in integer minor units; null for open-amount intents. Never float.

surface.description: Which realization presents the intent. Extensible.

surface_ref.description: Concrete artifact id (payment-link slug, qr_id, pr_id).

transfer_id.description: Transfer that fulfilled the intent. causation_id of that Transfer MUST equal this intent id (INV-TRACE-001).

lifecycle.description: CREATED -> REQUESTED -> PAID; CREATED/REQUESTED -> EXPIRED|CANCELLED|FAILED. PAID/EXPIRED/CANCELLED/FAILED are terminal. PAID only via a real confirmed Transfer.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
